method match_parens(lst: array<string>) returns (result: string)
    requires |lst| == 2
    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < |lst| ==> (lst[i] == "(" || lst[i] == ")")
    ensures result == "Yes" || result == "No"
    ensures (result == "Yes" ==> exists i, j :: (i < |lst| && j < |lst| && i != j && can_form_good_string(lst[i] + lst[j]))) 
    ensures (result == "No" ==> forall i, j :: (i < |lst| && j < |lst| && i != j ==> !can_form_good_string(lst[i] + lst[j]))

method can_form_good_string(s: string) returns (is_good: bool)
    ensures is_good == (count_open(s) == count_close(s) && balanced(s))
    
method count_open(s: string) returns (count: int)
    ensures count >= 0

method count_close(s: string) returns (count: int)
    ensures count >= 0

method balanced(s: string) returns (is_balanced: bool)
    ensures is_balanced ==> (forall i :: 0 <= i < |s| ==> (prefix_balance(s, i) >= 0))
    
method prefix_balance(s: string, i: int) returns (balance: int)
    requires 0 <= i <= |s|
    ensures balance == count_open(substr(s, 0, i)) - count_close(substr(s, 0, i))
```
